root_idea.summary: The root centers on the uncovering, emergence, and becoming-visible of something.
root_idea.development: From this orientation develop becoming manifest, making something clear or visible, polishing by removing obscurity, and departure or expulsion from a place. Related bodily, atmospheric, and figurative uses extend the same imagery of exposure and removal.

qac_form_accounting.reason: Quran-attested intransitive verb group with distinct usages of becoming manifest or bright.
Quran-attested causative verb group meaning to make visible or manifest.
Quran-attested nominal form with the specialized sense of exile.

senses.definition: To become clear, exposed, visible, or bright.
senses.usage_conditions: Used of something becoming manifest in itself; in the Quran this includes the daylight becoming bright and clear.

senses.definition: To become manifest to something or someone.
senses.usage_conditions: A transitive-with-preposition construction of manifestation to an object, as in the Quranic account of the Lord’s manifestation to the mountain; the sources report differing explanations of the mode of manifestation.

senses.definition: To make something clear, visible, exposed, or manifest; to display or disclose it.
senses.usage_conditions: A causative transitive use: the object may be physically displayed or made manifest, or an affair may be disclosed.

senses.definition: Exile; departure or expulsion from a homeland.
senses.usage_conditions: In the Quranic construction, the noun denotes the enforced removal or departure of a people from their homes.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To leave or emigrate from a country, town, home, or place; to disperse or flee from it.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The sources also report departure or dispersal caused by fear or drought, and departure while being driven away.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Partial baldness, especially of the forepart or half of the head.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The term denotes a degree of baldness less than complete baldness; the related verb describes the forepart of the head becoming bald.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To remove rust or an obscuring deposit and polish a sword, mirror, silver, or similar object.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The object is made bright by clearing its surface.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To remove or clear away anxiety, illness, or another affliction.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative transitive use in which the affliction is caused to depart from a person.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To cause a person or group to leave, emigrate, or be expelled.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The subject may be a person, a ruler, or an event such as drought; the object is driven from its home or place.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To drive bees out with smoke in order to collect the honey.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized causative use applied to bees.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To present or display a bride to her husband.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The construction may also describe the husband looking at the bride after her presentation.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of a hawk or falcon, to raise its head and look toward prey, or to open its eyes so as to see more clearly.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The related expression جَلَّى بِبَصَرِهِ describes casting the eyes like a hawk looking at prey.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To outstrip or come first in a race.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This sense is reported on the authority of one source and is not otherwise widely attested in the entry.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To act openly with someone concerning an affair.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A reciprocal Form III construction involving openness in dealing with another person.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To clear oneself away or withdraw from a slain person.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The source gives this as a specialized intransitive construction.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To hasten while running; to become distant or remote and hasten.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An intransitive use with emphasis on rapid movement or increasing distance.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To look at a thing from a higher position.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This Form V use describes viewing an object while standing above it.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Our states or conditions became disclosed to one another.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A reciprocal construction describing mutual revelation of each party’s condition.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To become removed or cleared away, especially of anxiety, darkness, or an affair.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The construction اِنْجَلَى عَنْهُ الهَمُّ means that anxiety departed from him; darkness is used as a comparison.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To look at or view a person or thing.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The sense includes looking at a bride after her presentation.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To raise or remove a turban from the side of the forehead.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized physical uncovering of the forehead while folding back the turban.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To become polished or furbished, said of a sword and similar objects.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An intransitive resultative use describing an object becoming bright and polished.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To go forth or emigrate from one country or town to another.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized Form XII verb of relocation.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A well-known, celebrated, or conspicuous person.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The idiom can refer to someone whose affairs are manifest or whose elevated position makes him conspicuous; it is also used as a personal name.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The dawn, the beginning of day, or, according to another report, the moon.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: These are reported figurative or alternative interpretations of the idiom, distinct from its use for a famous person.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A bridal gift presented by the husband to the bride at the time of her presentation.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The gift may be a female slave or another object.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An apparent, manifest, plain, or evident thing, affair, or case.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This nominal sense concerns the state of being clear, not the Quranic specialized sense of exile.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Acknowledgment or confession; in an alternate interpretation, evidence or proof accompanied by witnesses.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The sources preserve differing vocalization and interpretation for this legal or evidentiary use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The whiteness or bright duration of the day.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used in the expression for remaining somewhere during the brightness of a day.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Collyrium, especially a kind that clears the sight; antimony.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The name is explained by its sight-clearing effect.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A person’s honourable or good name or surname by which he is addressed.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A conventional interrogative expression about a person’s distinguished name.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Clear, unobscured, exposed, manifest, evident, or obvious.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used adjectivally of information, tidings, analogy, or a rule.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A seeing or perceptive eye.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A conventional description of an eye with clear sight.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Sure information or tidings; the true or real state of an affair.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A nominalized feminine form used for established information about a matter.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A medicine that clears the complexion or skin.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized adjectival use of جَلَّاءٌ for a cleansing or beautifying medicine.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The act of making something apparent, open, manifest, plain, or evident.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A verbal noun denoting the process of clarification or exposure.

other_classical_meanings.definition: One who goes forth or emigrates from his country or town.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The related collective جَالِيَةٌ can denote a company or people who have left their homes.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A group of emigrants, especially the non-Muslim protected subjects of a Muslim government.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The latter institutional use was extended to certain Jews and other scriptural or Magian communities subject to the poll tax, even when they had not personally emigrated.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The poll tax imposed on the protected non-Muslim subjects described by جَالِيَةٌ.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A substantivized use derived from the designation of those communities.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Bald at the forepart or sides of the forehead; by extension, handsome in face with this feature.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The adjective describes partial baldness rather than complete baldness.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A wide forehead; also, a cloudless sky or a bright, cloudless night.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The atmospheric use is figurative, describing an unobscured expanse.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A lion.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A reported figurative use of the related idiom ابن أجلى.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Because of you, on your account, or for your sake.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An idiomatic causal expression equivalent to مِنْ أَجْلِكَ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The forepart of the head, especially the first place where baldness appears; the part of the head visible when facing someone.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A singular noun related to the plural مَجَالٍ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Causing someone to emigrate or be driven from home.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used adjectivally of something such as a war that forces people into exile.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The first horse in a race.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A substantivized racing term.
